note: Diversity knobs: one axis, three options, prose in words only (no frame counts, fps or amplitudes in prose; those belong to the post plan). Each option names the passages behind it and the catalog rows it prefers. Untested until rendered.

grounded_martial_arts.prose: Compact, sharp, grounded and controlled: strong weight, sudden time, direct space, bound flow; every strike stops where it lands and the body settles over its support.

late_90s_ova_sakuga.prose: An explosive burst that locks into a hard graphic pose: strong weight, sudden time, direct space, flow free through the strike and bound the instant the pose holds.

supernatural_terminal_descent.prose: Momentum redirected through a continuous contact chain: strong weight, sudden time with a brief hold at each redirection, direct space, bound flow; nothing stops, everything is passed on.

continuous_real_time.prose: Character drawings change on every frame at an unbroken real-time cadence; no held drawings.

twos_with_impact_hold.prose: Character drawings change on twos; on every landed strike the contact drawing is held while rain and effects keep moving on ones.

mixed_exposure_contact_key.prose: Drawings on twos through travel, on ones through the fastest instant of a strike, then a held contact key at impact; effects run on ones throughout.

none.prose: Clean anatomical limb arcs with no smears; speed is shown by spacing between drawings.

limb_smear.prose: The striking limb stretches into a smear along its path for its fastest instant; head, torso and the off-hand guard stay solid and sharp.

trajectory_smear.prose: A short trajectory smear traces the strike path and resolves at the contact point, preserving head identity and the contact destination.

compression_only.prose: Tissue compression at the contact point and nothing else; effects emit from the contact after the contact frame.

monochrome_flash.prose: A single held monochrome drawing at contact with a black speed-line burst, then the normal palette returns on the next drawing; effects emit from the contact after the contact frame.

inverse_flash_and_ring.prose: An inverse-color contact drawing and a concentric shock ring as the stored force fractures the surface under the receiver; effects emit from the contact after the contact frame.

locked_medium_wide.prose: A stable medium-wide three-quarter view throughout, with handheld tension only after an impact; every contact stays locked.

low_angle_push.prose: A low angle with a brief push-in before each contact, then locked across the contact itself; no move during a hit.

lateral_countertrack.prose: A lateral counter-track that follows the footwork between exchanges, with a short impulse shake that begins on the contact frame and never before it.
